answer: Each epoch, peers challenge participants to forge a valid signature chain, and failed proofs burn the stake. Agents must stake a unique jade token bound to a hardware root of trust; duplicating reputation slot requires acquiring a second opal certificate from a bonded registrar, an attacker cost exceeding the expected reward of any single epoch. This makes mass fake identities economically irrational, preserving honest quorum. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
